title: Pass --cell-id on door-prepared cell dispatches
action: In prepare.rs's Resolved::Herding arm (around :2480-2531), append ` --cell-id "<id>"` to the composed command when kind == "cell", placed directly after the --agent block and before the --no-pane check. D1: herding arm only - the Cli arm runs a user-configured binary and the native arms spawn no herding process, so neither runs postflight_cap_check. D2: quoted like --agent/--seat; non-cell kinds keep byte-identical commands. Then update the five byte-exact cell-row assertions this changes: prepare.rs:5860 and tests.rs:1417, :1451, :1488, :1518. Add one test proving the flag rides a cell command and rides no other kind.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --bin bee drivers

truths: A kind=cell herding dispatch carries --cell-id with the cell's id
gather, reviewer and advisor commands are byte-identical to before
The id herding run parses is --cell-id, never --cell

artifacts.substantive: the --cell-id push_str in the Herding arm

key_links: postflight_cap_check in herding/run.rs:4065 returns Proceed on a None cell id - this flag is what makes the refusal reachable
prohibitions: No change to herding run's own flag parsing

trace.outcome: Pass --cell-id on door-prepared cell dispatches, making the cap refusal reachable
deviations: sync-ack: No skill text is stale: this is the dispatch door's own command composition. bee-swarming already tells the orchestrator to run exactly the tool and payload `dispatch prepare` returns, and nothing in any skill spells out that command's flags — an agent never types it by hand.
trace.verification_evidence: 415 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored. Proven red first: with the --cell-id block stripped from prepare.rs the new test fails at tests.rs:1546 with left ".bee/bin/bee herding run --task-file - --json" vs right the same plus --cell-id \"c-1\" (exit 101), restored green. And green:live — the leader re-ran the real door with the freshly built binary: `bee dispatch prepare --cell dcif-1 --kind cell --runtime claude` now emits `... --agent "agy-flash" --cell-id "dcif-1" --ceiling 1800`, where the SAME command captured from this feature's own dispatch at prep time — the before-state on main — carried no cell id at all; --kind gather and --kind advisor are byte-identical to that before-state

mistakes.better: measure a baseline with CARGO_TARGET_DIR pointed at a scratch dir, because a number read through a target dir another checkout also writes is not a measurement (the isolated re-run says the base is green at 414)

mistakes.wrong: The worker left an untracked packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/.bee/ directory behind, a stray store from running a bee verb inside the crate dir
mistakes.better: a worker should run bee verbs from the worktree root, and the cap should have caught the dirty path instead of the leader spotting it in git status
